dataset.name: google/fleurs
dataset.attribution: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech, Alexis Conneau and collaborators, Google Research, 2022; distributed by google/fleurs on Hugging Face under CC-BY-4.0.

selection.method: First two Greek cases in the existing development manifest order, fixed by the review task before this new Auto/Small run. Prior development outputs are already exposed; no new inference informed this subset.
selection.purpose: Regression/default-route coverage of omitted model and omitted language form fields through actual upload, automatic Greek detection, SQLite, exports, cleanup and separate-interpreter retrieval.
selection.representativeness: Two previously exposed read-speech clips; not fresh semantic validation, an accuracy estimate or a broad retest.

audio_preparation: Downloaded the dataset viewer audio renditions unchanged. These are native recorded speech, not synthesized speech. Viewer audio encoding may differ from the original dataset container; exact downloaded bytes are identified by SHA-256. No trimming, enhancement or reference-conditioned decoding is performed.
